title: How to Give a Memorable Toast
speaker: Toastmasters International
zh: 【Toastmasters International】如何祝酒令人難忘（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Hi, I'm Ramona J. Smith , Toastmasters International 2018 World Champion of
cues.en: Hi, I'm Ramona J. Smith , Toastmasters International 2018 World Champion of
cues.zh: 大家好，我是 Ramona J. Smith，2018 年國際演講大師賽世界冠軍

cues.text: Public Speaking. Have you ever been asked to give a toast,
cues.en: Public Speaking. Have you ever been asked to give a toast,
cues.zh: 公開演講。你是否曾經被要求敬酒，

cues.text: but you didn't know what to say? I know first-hand that speaking in front of an
cues.en: but you didn't know what to say? I know first-hand that speaking in front of an
cues.zh: 但你不知道該說什麼？我直接知道在一個人面前講話

cues.text: audience is one of the most demanding situations you can face. Yet I'm one of millions of people
cues.en: audience is one of the most demanding situations you can face. Yet I'm one of millions of people
cues.zh: 觀眾是你可能面臨的最苛刻的情況之一。但我是數百萬人中的一員

cues.text: who Toastmasters has helped gain the confidence to communicate in all circumstances.
cues.en: who Toastmasters has helped gain the confidence to communicate in all circumstances.
cues.zh: Toastmasters 幫助他們獲得了在任何情況下進行溝通的信心。

cues.text: When friends gather to celebrate, some occasions are more formal than others, but even a formal
cues.en: When friends gather to celebrate, some occasions are more formal than others, but even a formal
cues.zh: 當朋友聚會慶祝時，有些場合比其他場合更正式，但即使是正式場合

cues.text: occasion doesn't have to be intimidating. The first tip will help you succeed with any toast.
cues.en: occasion doesn't have to be intimidating. The first tip will help you succeed with any toast.
cues.zh: 場合不一定是令人生畏的。第一個技巧將幫助您成功地完成任何祝酒。

cues.text: One: Keep it short and sweet One skill that Toastmasters learn is how to
cues.en: One: Keep it short and sweet One skill that Toastmasters learn is how to
cues.zh: 一：保持簡潔明瞭 Toastmasters 學習的一項技能是如何

cues.text: get to the point. With a toast, this is especially important. You want to stand up, raise your glass,
cues.en: get to the point. With a toast, this is especially important. You want to stand up, raise your glass,
cues.zh: 切入正題。對於敬酒，這一點尤其重要。你想站起來舉起酒杯

cues.text: and say a few words to make everyone smile, but do it in a way that is brief and engaging.
cues.en: and say a few words to make everyone smile, but do it in a way that is brief and engaging.
cues.zh: 說幾句話讓大家微笑，但要簡短而有吸引力。

cues.text: Since you're keeping it to a few minutes, what should you talk about?
cues.en: Since you're keeping it to a few minutes, what should you talk about?
cues.zh: 既然你只講幾分鐘，那你該講什麼？

cues.text: That might depend on the situation. Toasts happen at all types of events, not
cues.en: That might depend on the situation. Toasts happen at all types of events, not
cues.zh: 這可能要視具體情況而定。祝酒會發生在所有型別的活動中，而不是

cues.text: just weddings. For example, many memorial services reserve time for guests to honor the departed.
cues.en: just weddings. For example, many memorial services reserve time for guests to honor the departed.
cues.zh: 只是婚禮。例如，許多追悼會都會為客人預留時間來紀念死者。

cues.text: For a eulogy, it's a good idea to focus on celebrating the positive and most important
cues.en: For a eulogy, it's a good idea to focus on celebrating the positive and most important
cues.zh: 對於悼詞，最好專注於慶祝積極和最重要的事情

cues.text: parts of that person's life. Highlight a few remarkable things that they accomplished,
cues.en: parts of that person's life. Highlight a few remarkable things that they accomplished,
cues.zh: 該人生活的一部分。強調他們所完成的一些非凡的事情，

cues.text: but make it a short list. Platitudes, cliches, or long chronologies may not
cues.en: but make it a short list. Platitudes, cliches, or long chronologies may not
cues.zh: 但把它列成一個簡短的清單。陳腔濫調、陳腔濫調或長篇大論可能不會

cues.text: only bore some listeners; they will steal the impact of your message.
cues.en: only bore some listeners; they will steal the impact of your message.
cues.zh: 只會讓一些聽眾感到厭煩；他們會竊取你的訊息的影響力。

cues.text: Instead, try to express what gave that person joy and a sense of accomplishment.
cues.en: Instead, try to express what gave that person joy and a sense of accomplishment.
cues.zh: 相反，嘗試表達是什麼給了那個人快樂和成就感。

cues.text: For a wedding, speak from the heart, and wish the couple well.
cues.en: For a wedding, speak from the heart, and wish the couple well.
cues.zh: 婚禮上，要說出心裡的話，祝新人一切順利。

cues.text: You might mention one aspect of their relationship that you admire, but be sure it's appropriate.
cues.en: You might mention one aspect of their relationship that you admire, but be sure it's appropriate.
cues.zh: 你可能會提到他們關係中你欣賞的一方面，但要確保它是合適的。

cues.text: Two: Be Careful with humor Humor has a place in every toast, regardless of the setting, just remember to be empathetic to
cues.en: Two: Be Careful with humor Humor has a place in every toast, regardless of the setting, just remember to be empathetic to
cues.zh: 二：小心幽默 幽默在每一次祝酒中佔有一席之地，無論在什麼場合，只要記得要有同理心

cues.text: the honoree and the circumstances. For a wedding toast, avoid potentially embarrassing stories.
cues.en: the honoree and the circumstances. For a wedding toast, avoid potentially embarrassing stories.
cues.zh: 獲獎者和情況。對於婚禮祝酒詞，避免可能令人尷尬的故事。

cues.text: Risqu jokes or anecdotes as a part of a toast for any celebration can be hazardous.
cues.en: Risqu jokes or anecdotes as a part of a toast for any celebration can be hazardous.
cues.zh: 在任何慶祝活動的祝酒詞中講下流笑話或軼事可能是危險的。

cues.text: You're better off if you keep the focus on the person or the event being honored,
cues.en: You're better off if you keep the focus on the person or the event being honored,
cues.zh: 如果你把注意力集中在受表彰的人或事件上，你會過得更好，

cues.text: and not on stories the couple, their guests, or other honoree might find uncomfortable.
cues.en: and not on stories the couple, their guests, or other honoree might find uncomfortable.
cues.zh: 而不是關於這對夫婦、他們的客人或其他獲獎者可能會感到不舒服的故事。

cues.text: Three: Practice When your goal is a great toast, practice at least once or twice before the big event.
cues.en: Three: Practice When your goal is a great toast, practice at least once or twice before the big event.
cues.zh: 三：練習當你的目標是祝酒時，在大型活動之前至少練習一兩次。

cues.text: Rehearse the words you'd like to say, but also plan an opening.
cues.en: Rehearse the words you'd like to say, but also plan an opening.
cues.zh: 排練你想說的話，同時也要規劃一個開頭。

cues.text: To begin, stand up, raise your glass, and say, I'd like to propose a toast.
cues.en: To begin, stand up, raise your glass, and say, I'd like to propose a toast.
cues.zh: 首先，站起來，舉起酒杯，說：我想舉杯。

cues.text: Then, practice giving your fellow celebrants time to raise their glasses before you speak.
cues.en: Then, practice giving your fellow celebrants time to raise their glasses before you speak.
cues.zh: 然後，練習在發言前給其他司儀人員舉杯的時間。

cues.text: Also, you may not have access to a microphone, so if you'll be addressing a large gathering, it's
cues.en: Also, you may not have access to a microphone, so if you'll be addressing a large gathering, it's
cues.zh: 此外，您可能無法使用麥克風，因此如果您要在大型聚會上發表講話，

cues.text: a good idea to practice projecting your voice. Don't yell, but breathe deeply, and let your voice
cues.en: a good idea to practice projecting your voice. Don't yell, but breathe deeply, and let your voice
cues.zh: 練習發音的好點子。不要大喊大叫，而是深呼吸，讓你的聲音

cues.text: radiate from your center. Practice will help. With a little preparation and practice, you can
cues.en: radiate from your center. Practice will help. With a little preparation and practice, you can
cues.zh: 從你的中心輻射出來。練習會有幫助。透過一些準備和練習，您可以

cues.text: master the art of toasting and help make every celebration an event to remember. Cheers!
cues.en: master the art of toasting and help make every celebration an event to remember. Cheers!
cues.zh: 掌握敬酒藝術，讓每一次慶祝活動都成為難忘的事件。乾杯!
